home.title: Cross-Platform App
home.description: React + Vite + Capacitor starter with a shared codebase for the mobile app, the web PWA, and the admin dashboard.
home.loginCta: Log in to see your profile

assistant.title: Talk to the assistant
assistant.description: Ask your question out loud. Watch the answer in video, or just listen to it.

home.intro: Development UI for the text → ElevenLabs → LiveAvatar LITE → LiveKit → Egress pipeline. Everything provider-related runs on the server; this app only holds a scoped LiveKit subscriber token for the duration of a session.
home.phaseVerdict: PHASE 1: FAIL — the real provider path has not been verified yet.
home.phasePending: Pending: ElevenLabs real API, LiveAvatar LITE real API, public WSS LiveKit endpoint, real browser playback, real Avatar → Egress MP4.
home.creditNotice: Generate Audio and Send to Avatar can consume ElevenLabs / LiveAvatar credits when real credentials are configured on the server.
home.webrtcUnsupported: WebRTC is not available in this browser
home.insecureContext: Not a secure context: media playback and WebRTC may be blocked
